title: acs state fragment for /acs:docs-sync
description: What THIS skill records: the `states` keys it owns and, when it completes in more than one way, its closed `outcome` vocabulary. The envelope is validated centrally by step-state.schema.json; this fragment is why adding a skill is a directory rather than an edit to a central schema (§4.4).

files.description: Repo-relative paths of every doc file docs-sync itself changed and left uncommitted in the working tree (the union over every doc area's and the integration pass's doc-updater report); /acs:create-pr commits them (ADR-0127).

implemented.description: Repo-relative paths of the feature LLD documents this run moved from approved to implemented after a passing drift review, each on its gap analyst's implemented-candidate verdict (ADR-0137). Derived by the post-hook from each document's front matter: a listed path that does not read `status: implemented` is dropped.

guard_denials.description: Derived by the post-hook when the file-map guard denied a write; never written by the skill.
